data.title: 艾尔菲利亚 · 冰海浮台的夏日魔法
data.description: 【冰海温泉浮台·午后】艾尔菲利亚穿着冰蓝泳装坐在漂浮木台，脚边的海水凝成细小冰花；她一手举着冰镇果汁，一手让一只小冰鸟停在指尖，蓝瞳因为成功的魔法而闪亮。
data.location: floating platform on a magical ice sea
data.action: 冰海浮台上让海水绽成冰花，举果汁展示停在指尖的小冰鸟
data.lighting: bright afternoon light through crystalline spray
data.promptProse: Elfaria Alvis Serfort sits on the floating wooden platform in an ice-blue swimsuit and white shoulder wrap, holding chilled fruit juice in one hand while an ice bird rests on her other fingertip. Small frost flowers form beside her feet in the seawater. The horizontal medium view includes the platform ropes and bright spray behind. Afternoon sunlight passes through the bird and crystal hair clasp, casting cool glints onto her delighted blue-eyed face.
